purpose: Auditable source-level policy evidence for catalog discovery and safe ingestion. These reviews are not legal advice and do not grant record-level rights clearance.

policy.rule: A source-level policy review never clears every page or asset on a host. Require record-level provenance, content-origin classification, applicable license/terms, privacy review, and attribution before publication.

findings: NIST states that site information is public and may be distributed or copied except material marked copyrighted; appropriate byline/photo/image credits are requested.
NIST employee-created data and works outside the Standard Reference Data Act are generally not protected by U.S. copyright, but foreign copyright may apply.
NIST Standard Reference Data may be protected under 15 U.S.C. § 290e and must follow the specific SRD license terms.
Contractor, extramural, and other third-party material may carry separate rights or conditions; technical publications may include third-party works.
mandatory_checks: Classify each candidate as NIST employee-created non-SRD, SRD, contractor/extramural, third-party, or unknown.
Do not redistribute SRD or third-party content without its applicable license or permission.
Preserve NIST attribution and recommended dataset/software citation details.
Keep unknown-origin content metadata-only and non-commercial.
reviews.api_access: No API access approval inferred from this page-level review.

findings: NPS says material it created and presents is generally public domain unless otherwise indicated.
NPS warns that third-party copyright, trademark, privacy, publicity, donor restrictions, and contractual restrictions may apply.
NPS marks, including the Arrowhead insignia, are protected trademarks and may not be used without prior written permission.
For commercial publication or republication of NPS-created material, the copyright notice must state that no protection is claimed in the original U.S. Government work.

api_access.rate_limit_scope: per API key across developer.nps.gov API requests
api_access.rule: Do not call the NPS API until a valid project-owned key is available; obey response rate-limit headers and the rolling hourly quota.

mandatory_checks: Distinguish NPS-created records from third-party or donor-supplied material.
Do not republish third-party photos, films, music, graphics, or other assets without record-level permission.
Do not use NPS trademarks or insignia without permission.
Preserve attribution and the required government-work notice for commercial republication of eligible NPS-created material.

findings: The Census API terms permit building services to search, display, analyze, retrieve, view, and otherwise obtain Census Bureau data.
Applications using the API must display the Census Bureau's non-endorsement attribution notice.
API data must not be modified or falsely represented as Census content.
Census data must not be combined or used to identify individual people, households, businesses, or other respondents; do not publish combinations that identify respondents.
The Census Bureau may limit or terminate API access for policy or usage violations.

api_access.rate_limit_policy: Follow current API guidance and response behavior; do not rely on older no-key daily limits.

reviews.required_attribution: This product uses the Census Bureau Data API but is not endorsed or certified by the Census Bureau.
mandatory_checks: Do not call the Census API until a valid project-owned free key is available.
Display the required non-endorsement notice wherever API data is presented.
Do not combine Census data with other datasets in a way that identifies respondents.
Preserve dataset title, vintage, API base URL, and access date for citation.
Do not infer a blanket license for non-API Census website articles, images, or third-party materials.

next_gate: Implement record-level policy matching against these source rules. Keep all existing candidates preview-only until the record origin, applicable terms, attribution, privacy, and reuse basis are verified.
